instruction: CORRECTNESS-lens R1 review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020L (first rule-RFC dogfood) at branch feature/wp-scp-022-020l-rule-rfc-dogfood. Both are RE2-compatible; verify there's no edge case (e.g. Unicode whitespace handling) where they would diverge on the fixture corpus. Verify by reading policies/VERSIONING.md the rule-add semver mapping. (6) §10 open questions: each question is correctly classified as `[BLOCKING]` (changes match scope, severity, bypass surface, or conflict-gate strategy) vs `[deferrable]` (implementation detail). Verify the three `[BLOCKING]` questions and the four `[deferrable]` questions are categorized correctly per RULE-TEMPLATE.md §10 guidance (lines 152-166 of RULE-TEMPLATE.md).
